scope_choice: Keep the Unix glue language small; dimensions judged by the scoped 8/10 definitions in issues #243-#254
status: rubric-8 campaign round 1: no dimension at 8
binary_under_test: target/release/execute.exe (Windows 11 ARM64, built 2026-10-17 22:47 local, before the last perf-only commits to HEAD); Linux numbers from CI run 39101832218 at 4e27d85

dimensions.name: Readability
evidence: Simple pipelines read as prose (README quickstart, docs/language.md 'Reading a program' table)
jq inside 193/384 example programs; models/* each carry 3 near-identical jq calls a non-programmer cannot read
Playground demos spawn printf to set a variable 108 times in 29 of 30 demos (web/examples.json)
7 playground dashboards are one printf JSON template with %s/%d (web/examples.json incident-command:50, cert-expiry:65)
web-traffic demo: 'tally' helper = grep -F, count lines, parse json, take integer, encode, compare as text "0"; ranking by textual sort -r of uniq -c
examples/omarchy-rewrites/10-theme-set-vscode.program:87-100 builds a 3-field record in 13 lines although {"path": path} literals work
explain prints Rust Debug: 'if Reference("greeting") contains String("x")' (repro, #223)

dimensions.name: AI generation efficiency
evidence: Grammar page is EBNF and every program block is parsed by tests/lane_a_grammar_doc.rs
351/354 example programs and 30/30 playground demos pass check
check --json reports ok:true, exit 0 with five error diagnostics on a program run accepts (repro, #102, #101)
check rejects 'and stderr to FILE' that run accepts (repro, #123)
Undefined name: code check_failed, no span, no suggestion (repro, filed #258)
0/131 manifests carry a description; 'applets inspect "uppercase text"' -> unknown applet (filed #259)
then text.upper fails ('requires parameter text') while then text.lines works (filed #260)
No held-out benchmark; the public pilot is 3 tasks, 6 cases (benchmarks/ai_productivity/public_pilot_2026_10_15/summary.md, #242)

dimensions.name: Declarative expressiveness
evidence: Object literals take bound references: json.stringify with value {"path": path} works (repro); text.render templates exist
json.get/set/map/filter, number.*, csv/yaml/toml/ini parse and stringify are in-process
No aggregation: counting, summing, grouping and ranking go to awk (17 programs) or complex jq (222 calls) (#235)
170 jq -n --arg calls in 76 programs only build an object from variables
Naming a constant needs an applet call (filed #261)
Failure records carry kind/status/signal but no errno class (#238)

dimensions.name: Reactive programming
evidence: listen to / whenever, every, on schedule with missed-tick policies, stream from, dbus/hypr/tail.follow sources, service generate (docs/language.md Listener and schedule semantics)
Backpressure through the producer pipe; try/catch inside a handler isolates a bad record (repro)
Unhandled handler failure ends the service; one trigger per file
and stdout to stderr loses 'one' on timeout (repro, #211); stderr to FILE loses stderr on timeout (#140)
Early-exit consumer: Windows prints 'applet "seq" failed (exit code: 3328)' yet exits 0; Unix fails the group (#137, #174)
Trickling daemon client stalls the daemon (#191)

dimensions.name: Composability
evidence: Reusable programs, run program file, versioned program modules with locks, typed applet contracts and typed graph ports
Program-call results are bytes: playground tally returns encoded JSON compared as text (#237)
for each over a parsed JSON string array cannot pass item to argv ('reference item contains json') without take (repro)
Labels on run program dropped (#105); module bodies invisible to explain and the gate (#216); bare module manifest fails (#141)

dimensions.name: Type safety
evidence: check validates parameter names, manifest types, typed inputs, both branches and per-path result types before effects
number.add result passed to text.upper's text passes check, fails at run (repro, filed #257)
if <integer> is "3" passes check, fails at run (repro, filed #257)
json.filter equals 1 misses 1.0 and 1e0 (repro, #200); /a/x on an array is status 2 not absence (repro, #199)
0755 literal passes check and runs as 755 (repro, #189); temporary-scope leak (#213)

dimensions.name: Error handling
evidence: try/catch/finally, on exit, on interrupt drain, retry with backoff gated by effect certainty, exit/fail, typed failure records
Caught failure record has stdout_captured:false; the command's 'partial-out' is neither printed nor captured (repro, #233)
on exit looping 60 times: 'cleanup step budget of 128 exceeded', exit 1, main output dropped (repro, #205)
Resume of a checkpointed program with on exit: 'try end without active try' (repro, #160)
io_error carries errno only inside message text (repro, #238); stderr truncated at 8 KiB (#139)
Main CI: omarchy rewrite test expects status 9 from a failed notification, gets 0 (run 39101779516)

dimensions.name: Scalability
evidence: Native pipes stream: count.lines over 57 MB at 10.7 MB peak; 100 MB pipe at parity with bash (CI)
Flat 20,000-statement program checks in 0.20 s
Bracketed continuation parse: 5k items 0.32 s, 10k 1.11 s, 20k 4.02 s (repro, #107)
check --json on N bad lines: 5k 0.40 s, 10k 1.29 s, 20k 4.71 s (repro, #172)
8.1 MB JSON parse peaks at 128 MB; json.map refuses a 120,000-item array at 326 MB (repro, filed #262)
Open quadratic paths #202, #203, #204, #206, #167; unbounded --record #188

dimensions.name: Determinism
evidence: Journal v5, per-element checkpoints, keyed digests, content-derived step ids, documented interval/cron semantics

on exit + resume broken (repro, #160)

Native checks red on every main push since 7bbbc07 (2026-10-17): 17 omarchy rewrite output/status mismatches vs bash (#80)
